info.title: English Practice API — implementation contract
info.description: Contract-first specification. Health, authentication (register, login, refresh, logout, password forgot/reset/change) current-profile, dashboard, attempt history, capabilities, topic and persona operations, all four practice flows (Writing, Reading, Listening, Speaking), private media metadata/download and AI job operations are implemented. Nothing is planned and marked x-implementation-status=planned. Import this file for design review; the running FastAPI /openapi.json and /docs remain limited to implemented routes. Requests reject unknown fields. Owner identity comes from the verified session. No 500-character Writing limit; live transcription is optional. All examples are synthetic; capacity and token lifetime examples do not establish deployment policy.

servers.description: Local development; only operations marked implemented currently respond.

get.description: Implemented. Does not depend on PostgreSQL or the AI service.
Implemented. Checks PostgreSQL connectivity only, not migrations or AI availability. Uses the existing compact health error response.

post.description: Normalize email (trimmed, lowercased) and trim display name. Never trim passwords. Password policy: 8–256 characters (configurable), no composition rules; passphrases welcome. Confirmation must match and is never stored. Duplicate email returns 409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED. Continue to login after registration. Rate limited per client.

Returns a short-lived bearer access token bound to a revocable session and an opaque refresh token. Wrong email, wrong password and inactive accounts all return the same 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS. Rate limited per client and email. Tokens are synthetic in examples.

Atomically rotate the refresh token and extend the session (sliding expiry, default 30 days). Of concurrent requests with one token, exactly one succeeds. A rotated, revoked, expired or unknown token returns 401 INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN; replaying a rotated token does not revoke the session (no token-family history).
Revoke the current session. Its access token stops working immediately, before natural expiry, and its refresh token can no longer rotate. No Idempotency-Key required for auth routes.

Identical 202 response for known, unknown and inactive emails; the message is delivered after responding. Never returns the reset token. Tokens expire after 30 minutes (configurable), work once, and a new request voids older ones. Rate limited per client and per email. No email provider is configured yet: development writes messages to a local outbox; production returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE until a provider exists.

value.message: If an account exists, password reset instructions will be sent.

post.description: Consume a single-use, expiring token. Invalid, expired or used tokens return 422 INVALID_RESET_TOKEN. A weak or mismatched new password returns 422 without consuming the token. Revokes all sessions; log in again.

Verify the current password (wrong value returns 422 with field current_password, not 401, so the app does not treat it as an expired session). Revokes all sessions, including the current one; log in again.

get.description: Profile of the authenticated session's user. Never includes hashes or tokens.

patch.description: Update display name only (trimmed, 1–100 characters). Role and email cannot be changed; unknown fields return 422.

get.description: resume_attempt is the most recently active in_progress attempt (last_activity_at DESC, attempt_id DESC) or null. pending_attempts are attempts waiting for evaluation (status submitted or evaluating), same order, capped at ten; has_more_pending tells the app to use GET /attempts?status=... for the rest.

Configured limits and supported features. max_request_bytes is enforced for every request (413 CAPACITY_EXCEEDED). Audio limits apply once uploads are implemented. live_transcription and pronunciation_assessment stay false until implemented and verified.
Active topics ordered by name. Seeded with `make seed`; 'random' is a topic mode, not a topic.
Active AI personas ordered by name. Behavior instructions and voice keys are never returned.

post.description: Persist request and queue generation. Poll returned job; fetch the exercise when ready. Missing topic defaults to random. Existing data remains readable if the AI PC is offline. Rubric: writing-ielts-practice-v1 (four IELTS-style criteria, 0-9 half bands; practice estimate, not an official IELTS score). At most 3 generations may be in progress per user (429). target_word_count is a learning target, not a limit.

Persist request and queue generation. Poll returned job; fetch the exercise when ready. Missing topic defaults to random. Existing data remains readable if the AI PC is offline. Question types are assigned in order, cycling through question_types. Limits (configurable): at most 15 questions and 1,200 words (413); requested_word_count must allow 20 words per question (422). Default length: 150/200/300 words by difficulty. Generated passages must fall within ±40% of the target or generation retries. Short answers are graded 0, 0.5 or 1 point with rubric short-answer-v1.

Persist request and queue generation. One generate_exercise job writes the script and questions, renders the audio with TTS, validates the audio bytes (PCM WAV for now) and stores them privately; the exercise becomes ready only together with its ready, owned audio. Poll the returned job; fetch the exercise when ready. Missing topic defaults to random. Defaults: 3 questions; target length 80/120/180 words by difficulty (at least 20 words per question). More than 10 questions returns 413; requested sizes are never silently changed. Existing data remains readable if the AI PC is offline.

Persist request and queue generation. Poll returned job; fetch the exercise when ready. Missing topic defaults to random. Existing data remains readable if the AI PC is offline. persona_id must be an active persona (422 otherwise); the persona and the rubric speaking-ielts-practice-v1 are snapshotted on the exercise. Behaviour instructions are never returned.

get.description: Owned exercise only. While generation is incomplete: content null and questions empty. Never expose answer keys, rubric prompts, persona instructions, or Listening transcript. Currently implemented for Writing and Reading; Listening and Speaking are added with their modules.

post.description: Exercise must be owned and ready. Body {} starts fresh. Writing source_attempt_id copies the original submitted response into a new attempt. Speaking creates a session and queues its greeting. Exercise not ready returns 409. The copy uses the original submitted text, never the corrected text. Speaking returns the conversation and the start_conversation job; the greeting is message position 1.

get.description: Owner only, ordered by last_activity_at DESC then attempt_id DESC. Optional skill/status filters. score is null until a completed evaluation has a valid score. The opaque cursor is bound to the user and filters; reusing it with other filters returns 422.
Public resource views only. No locked feedback or keys. Speaking messages are fetched separately. Currently implemented for Writing and Reading; Listening and Speaking are added with their modules.

patch.description: Atomic revision check and save. Update listed draft answers; omitted answers remain. Submitted answers cannot change. Writing has no 500-character limit. Reading cannot skip earlier unsubmitted questions. Stale revision returns 409 REVISION_CONFLICT with current_revision; a non-in-progress attempt returns 409 STATE_CONFLICT. Reading: paragraph_index/offset must exist in the passage; current_question_id cannot skip an unsubmitted earlier question. Listening: playback_position_ms cannot exceed the audio duration; any question may be current (free navigation); answers stay editable until the whole quiz is submitted.

post.description: Reading only. Checks attempt revision and locks this answer before grading. MCQ returns immediate feedback; short answer queues grading. Increment attempt revision atomically. Earlier unsubmitted questions return 409 (no skipping); an already submitted answer returns 409. AnswerGradedResult.feedback is the same as GET .../feedback.

get.description: Reading: require this answer submitted and graded. Listening: require whole-attempt submission and this answer graded. Otherwise 409 FEEDBACK_LOCKED or GRADING_PENDING. Other question keys remain hidden. Failed or cancelled grading returns 409 GRADING_FAILED. Multiple choice: is_correct and correct_option_id. Short answer: is_correct null, reference_answer and the grader's comment before the explanation.

post.description: Writing requires nonblank text. Reading requires all answers submitted and graded. Listening locks all nonempty answers atomically; short-answer jobs feed a coordinating evaluation job. Speaking uses /finish (this route returns 409 for Speaking). Return deterministic results or the coordinating AI job. Writing returns 202 with the evaluate_attempt job. Text above the configured model capacity (default 20,000 characters) returns 413 and keeps the draft. Reading returns 200 with the final evaluation: overall_score is the percentage (max_score 100) and quiz_summary holds counts and points. Listening locks every saved answer together; any blank answer returns 409 STATE_CONFLICT with one details entry per question (field answers.<question_id>) and locks nothing. All multiple choice: 200 with the final evaluation. With short answers: 202 with the evaluate_attempt coordinator job, which waits for the grade_answer jobs and aggregates them (it never re-grades). If a grade fails, the coordinator fails (GRADING_FAILED); retrying the coordinator re-runs only failed or cancelled grades. Cancelling it cancels outstanding grades.

Freeze attempt, retain history, cancel queued work and invalidate running executions. End a Speaking conversation. Completed attempts cannot be cancelled; cancelled attempts cannot resume. Cancelling an already cancelled attempt returns it unchanged.

get.description: Return existing evaluation including pending/failed/cancelled states; 404 before it exists. No locked quiz feedback. Required unassessed criteria keep overall score null.
Listening only. Require submitted attempt or return 409 TRANSCRIPT_LOCKED. Evidence is included only for graded questions; it may be empty during grading.
Owned Speaking attempt only (404 if not owned, 409 for other skills). active_job is the one greeting or turn job still in progress.
Owned Speaking attempt only. Ordered by position ascending, paginated separately from attempt details.

post.description: Multipart upload (fields audio, client_message_key), then speech-to-text, the persona's reply and its audio in one process_voice_turn job. The recording is checked from its bytes: PCM WAV only for now (415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE otherwise), max_audio_bytes / max_audio_duration_ms from /capabilities (413). One active voice job per session including the greeting: 409 TURN_IN_PROGRESS (retryable). Paused: 409 CONVERSATION_PAUSED. Ended or not in progress: 409 CONVERSATION_ENDED. Too many turns: 413. Retry with the same client_message_key and identical audio returns the original turn and job (with any Idempotency-Key); the same key with different audio returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. No speech detected fails the job with NO_SPEECH_DETECTED. Failed or cancelled turns stay in history (with their recording) and are never sent to the model as context.
Prevent new turns; already accepted processing may finish. Repeating pause is harmless. Ended conversations return 409 CONVERSATION_ENDED.
Resume a paused conversation using persisted messages and context. Ended sessions cannot resume (409 CONVERSATION_ENDED).

Require at least one successful user turn (409 STATE_CONFLICT) and no voice job in progress (409 TURN_IN_PROGRESS). End the conversation and queue evaluate_attempt. Criteria needing audio (fluency_coherence, pronunciation) are assessed only by an engine with a verified audio assessor, which receives the original recordings; otherwise they are not_assessed with null scores, and the overall band stays null. Transcript-only pronunciation scoring is not allowed.

get.description: Owner only (404 otherwise). available is false once the media is deleted or expired; results that used it stay readable.

Check owner and readiness before streaming. Return 404 for missing/not owned, 409 MEDIA_NOT_READY for pending/failed, 410 MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE for expired/deleted owned media (or a missing stored file). A single byte range is supported (bytes=a-b, bytes=a-, bytes=-n); invalid, unsatisfiable or multiple ranges return 416 RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE with Content-Range: bytes */size. Responses are Cache-Control: private, no-store. Replay never reruns TTS.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Optional single byte range, e.g. bytes=0-1023.

get.description: Return public state and safe references only. Poll with backoff; never expose worker leases, counters, prompts or raw provider errors.

post.description: Queued jobs cancel immediately (200); running jobs enter cancel_requested and increment execution_version (202). Late results are discarded. Already succeeded returns 409 ALREADY_COMPLETED. Cancelling an evaluation coordinator cancels outstanding child grading. Cancelling an evaluation keeps the submission and makes the attempt failed (retryable).

post.summary: Retry failed or cancelled AI work
post.description: Only retryable work on noncancelled parents. Fresh execution version, reset retry counter. Completed child grades remain; retry only failed children. Otherwise 409.

bearerAuth.description: Access token tied to a revocable session. UUIDs are not authorization.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: New UUID for each new operation. Reuse the same key and identical payload when retrying that operation; different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Error.description: Stable code; do not expose internal exceptions. current_revision is present for REVISION_CONFLICT.

JobResultRefs.description: Allowlisted public IDs only; no provider payloads, paths, or prompts.

Score.description: value <= max. Practice score only, not an official IELTS score.

Question.description: No answer keys. Short answers have no options; MCQs have at least two.

Span.description: Zero-based Unicode code points, start inclusive/end exclusive; end >= start and original must match the exact stored source. Flutter must convert to UTF-16 offsets.

Correction.description: Same offsets as Span. Unique correction_id, sorted non-overlapping spans. One insertion per position. Applies to original Writing response, never corrected_text.

Criterion.description: Unassessed criteria have null scores. Missing pronunciation assessment must not become zero.

examples.feedback: Audio pronunciation assessment is not yet available.

QuizSummary.description: Available only after all questions are graded. correct_count is null for mixed/open-answer quizzes.

Evaluation.description: Overall and max score are both null or valid. Required unassessed criteria keep the overall score null even when feedback is complete. Corrections only apply to Writing.
